messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: production error rate spike for model-id=rw-infer-7b-v3. Canary started 03:12 UTC with new weight bundle 'weights-2026-03b'. Error rate 8% -> 42% across canaries. Escalation: on-call paging triggered.
mike_oncall: I’m on it, investigating canary logs now. Which clusters are affected?
jen_sre: seeing garbled token outputs and frequent 'decode_failure' from tokenizer service on canary nodes in us-west-2a. Logs show tokenizer v2.1 vs expected v2.0.
sam_ml: that sounds like a tokenizer mismatch — model was built against tokenizer v2.0. Did the deploy pipeline promote a weight bundle without the tokenizer pin?
eva_prod: We started getting customer reports of truncated/garbled completions ~03:15 UTC, some critical customers with conversational agents impacted. Ticket incoming.
maria_ops: deploy-bot reports deploy job 2026-03b finished at 03:11 UTC. Artifacts: weights-2026-03b, tokenizers:v2.1, config: rollout/fast.
alex_platform: Confirmed. Artifact manifest shows tokenizers:v2.1 was auto-picked by the artifact promoter due to loose pin in model.yaml. That's the drift.
mike_oncall: Rolling traffic back from canary to previous stable model. Initiating feature-flag kill-switch: ffctl set model-serving.rw-infer-7b-v3.force_version=weights-2025-12a
jen_sre: I’m toggling kill-switch now. Observability: dropping canary traffic to 0% for that variant.
deploy-bot: command accepted: ffctl set ... -> success. Canary route removed at 03:19 UTC.
sam_ml: Quick check: do we need to force rebind tokenizer on the runtime or rollback weights? Preference is to unroll the tokenizer change so weights and tokenizer match.
maria_ops: We should revert artifact pointer to weights-2025-12a + tokenizer v2.0. I’ll create a rollback release.
eva_prod: Can we confirm customer impact window and affected tenants? I’ll start drafting comms for customers impacted between 03:12-03:19 UTC.
alex_platform: Oncall note: prefix cache/KV may have cached tokenized prefixes from v2.1; we need to evict caches for the canary shards to avoid cross-contamination if we reapply.
mike_oncall: Executing rollback: redwoodctl release set-version rw-infer-7b-v3 --artifact=weights-2025-12a --tokenizer=tokenizers:v2.0 --reason="emergency rollback after tokenizer drift"
jen_sre: rollback in progress. Watching rollout health. Also hitting a few rate-limit alarms on dedicated nodes due to retry storms, throttling applied.
deploy-bot: rollback job started at 03:22 UTC, job id jb-2026-0311-452.
sam_ml: After rollback, we should run a quick eval suite (sanity prompts) against canaries before re-promoting. I’ll prepare a 10-query smoke test.
maria_ops: Cache eviction command sent to edge-caches: curl -XPOST https://ops-api/cache/evict -d '{"model":"rw-infer-7b-v3","shards":"canary"}' ; confirmed 03:24 UTC.
eva_prod: Customer comms draft: "We detected malformed output from a recent model artifact promotion affecting a subset of canary traffic between 03:12-03:19 UTC. We've reverted the model and are monitoring. If you saw corrupted responses, please reply and we’ll assist." Send after we verify rollback success.
mike_oncall: Rollback completed 03:27 UTC. Error rate dropped to baseline ~0.5% on canaries. I’m keeping the kill-switch engaged until we validate artifact pinning and a clean re-promote.
jen_sre: Post-rollback checks: tokenizer versions now v2.0 across serving nodes, no decode_failure traces in last 10 minutes.
sam_ml: Smoke tests pass on canary group (10/10). Ready for controlled re-release after we fix the manifest.
alex_platform: I pushed a hotfix to the promoter: require exact tokenizer pin for model manifests. New policy in CI to fail if tokenizer missing. PR merged 03:36 UTC.
maria_ops: Setting a short-lived block on auto-promotes until after tomorrow’s release window.
eva_prod: Comms sent to affected customers 03:40 UTC. Logs show three tenants reported issues; ops ticket IDs attached.
mike_oncall: Handing off to daytime oncall @jen for follow-ups and post-incident review. I’ll update the incident doc with timeline. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
jen_sre: Taking over. I’ll open a postmortem and assign action items: manifest validation, cache-eviction playbook update, and alert tuning for tokenizer-version drift.
incident-bot: Incident resolved: STATUS=mitigated, severity=SEV3, duration=00:28:21, incident_id=INC-2026-0311-19
